goals.title: Complete the friends-test version of the native iPhone/iPad Industria...
goals.objective: Complete the friends-test version of the native iPhone/iPad Industrial City Birmingham app from the verified Phase 1 UI prototype. Exclude online/WebSocket multiplayer, accounts, payments, rankings, public release, anti-cheat, AI, and host migration. Preserve the approved high-fidelity UI and Transport abstraction. Deliver sequentially: (1) pure Swift authoritative GameCore and protocol primitives, implementing 2/3/4-player setup, legal actions, both eras, round/turn order, resources/markets, industries, scoring, deterministic full-game replay tests against RULES.md; (2) a two-simulator local-development room transport with create/join, seats/readiness, host start, authoritative PlayerIntent -> GameEvent -> per-seat snapshot synchronization, private-hand isolation, one complete synchronized action first and then full UI integration; (3) nearby offline 2-4 device transport for airplane scenarios using current Apple-supported local networking APIs behind the same Transport interface, with discovery, permissions, reconnect, state mismatch recovery, host-loss pause; (4) autosave, background/foreground resume, reconnect tokens, version/checksum recovery; (5) complete original game data/map/card/industry content and proportional iPhone/iPad accessibility/performance/device verification. Use TDD and verify every story before checkpointing. Architecture invariants: GameCore imports no SwiftUI/SpriteKit/network frameworks; UI emits intents and never decides legality; host is authoritative; ordinary clients never receive other players private hands; authoritative versions are monotonic and distinct from UI action number; nearby and simulator transports share one protocol; no online server work.
